en: This is a vintage postcard featuring a photograph of an outdoor concert platz in a landscaped park with many benches, trees, and people gathered, presumably watching a performance in a pavilion or bandstand. The postcard is titled 'Bad Pyrmont Konzertplatz im Kurpark.' The back of the postcard shows handwritten text, an old German stamp, and postmark, as well as a printed museum/logo. The handwritten address is in German.
